clue.text: Call to collect lady's tree

indicators.note: a word that collects another holds it inside itself

parts.note: to call out is to cry
the lady's is hers, so her stands in for the possessive

explanation.surface: Someone shouts for a woman to come and gather up her tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruiting cherry is a familiar ornamental and orchard tree.

clue.text: Writer caught King Henry visiting windy Hove

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: a visitor goes inside the place
windy means blown about, so the letters are scattered

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
H is the symbol for the henry, a unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A writer is arrested while the king is staying in breezy Hove, a seaside town in Sussex.
explanation.walkthrough: 'windy' gives HEOV, which 'visiting' opens to take in King Henry.
explanation.definitionFit: Anton Chekhov was the Russian playwright and short-story author.

clue.text: Carefully moves and stands out of line

indicators.note: out of means without, so a letter leaves the word

parts.note: easels are stands for paintings

explanation.surface: Someone gently shifts some furniture and sets it out of alignment.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease something is to manoeuvre it slowly and gently into place.

clue.text: Rose and Mabel nervously welcomed by bishop

indicators.note: welcomed by means taken in by, so the jumbled letters go inside

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop

indicators.note: nervously suggests agitation, so the letters fidget into a new order

explanation.surface: Rose and Mabel, two anxious women, are greeted by a bishop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nervously' turns MABEL into AMBLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A rambler is a climbing rose with long trailing stems.

clue.text: Indian holy man with book hugs old tree

indicators.note: the holy man and book wrap their arms round the next piece, holding it inside

parts.note: a baba is a revered holy man in India

explanation.surface: An Indian sage with a book in his arms embraces an ancient tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hugs' puts O inside BABAB, after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The baobab is an African and Australian tree with a huge swollen trunk.

clue.text: Fly polished off by means of pins

indicators.note: to pin something is to hold it fast, gripping it inside

parts.note: to polish off food is to have eaten it
via means by means of

explanation.surface: An insect is finished off by being stuck with pins, as in a collection.
explanation.definitionFit: To aviate is to pilot an aircraft, a formal word for flying.

clue.text: Cut holes in plain material for models

indicators.note: the cut and the holes go in the plain word

parts.note: bald means plain, unadorned
to saw is to cut
O looks like a hole, so two holes are OO

explanation.surface: Instructions to drill holes in some plain stuff used for model-making.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut holes' looks like a single instruction; it is two pieces, a verb and the round-letter holes.
explanation.definitionFit: Balsa is a very light, soft wood favoured by makers of model aircraft.

clue.text: Manager mainly recruiting Dutch and German woodworkers

indicators.note: recruiting means taking on, bringing others inside
mainly means most of it, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a boss is a manager

explanation.surface: A manager hires Dutch and German carpenters.
explanation.walkthrough: BOSS loses its final S, and DGER goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Bodgers were traditional craftsmen who turned chair legs from green wood in beech woods.

clue.text: A loud warning by driver: "Halt! Tree planting here!"

parts.note: F, forte, is the musical direction for loud
Fore is the golfer's shout of warning after a drive
a halt is a small railway station

explanation.surface: A golfer shouts a loud warning, then tells everyone to stop because trees are being planted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driver' is the golf club, not a motorist.
explanation.definitionFit: Afforestation is the establishment of a forest by putting in saplings.

clue.text: Employ so-called traditional churchyard residents

indicators.note: so-called says the word is as it is called, that is, as spoken

parts.note: to employ something is to use it

explanation.surface: A wry phrase for the long-lived things a churchyard is said to employ.
explanation.definitionFit: Yew trees are planted in English churchyards by long custom, so they are its age-old inhabitants.

clue.text: Show writer's Just a Boy alongside Journey's End

parts.note: the setter refers to what belongs to the writer as 'my'
just means fair
a boy is a lad

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: Reads like a book listing: an author's work 'Just a Boy' beside one called 'Journey's End'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Journey's End' looks like the play's title, but only gives the last letter of Journey.
explanation.definitionFit: My Fair Lady is the famous stage musical, so a show.

clue.text: Cut and slice bananas round tip of branch

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go round the next piece, enclosing it
bananas is slang for crazy, so the letters go wild
the tip of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Instructions to cut and slice bananas, with a branch tip thrown in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bananas' turns SLICE into CISEL, and 'round' puts the H from 'tip of branch' inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To chisel is to carve or shape wood or stone by cutting with an edged tool.

clue.text: Public backing agreement to import whiskey that's banned

parts.note: news that is out is public

indicators.note: to import something is to bring it inside
backing means going backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a deal is an agreement
Whiskey is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A public trade deal that would bring in banned whiskey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reverses DEAL to LAED; 'to import' puts W in it, giving LAWED.
explanation.definitionFit: Something outlawed has been made illegal, that is, prohibited.

clue.text: Little work on in flat that's always fresh

indicators.note: the small unit and the preposition go in the level word

parts.note: flat means even, as of a surface
an erg is a tiny unit of work in physics
re means on, concerning

explanation.surface: A modest job done in an apartment that keeps it looking new.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flat' reads as an apartment in the surface, but it means level.
explanation.definitionFit: An evergreen thing stays green and lively year round, never stale.

clue.text: Hedges here, heading off fierce attacks

indicators.note: heading off means the head, the first letter, comes off

parts.note: broadsides are fierce verbal attacks, from a ship firing all its guns at once

explanation.surface: Someone hedges, evading a fierce attack by heading it off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hedges' looks like a verb meaning dodges; it is the shrubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Hedgerows commonly line the verges at the edges of country lanes.

clue.text: Pines losing needles primarily get turned into these?

definitions.text: Pines losing needles primarily get turned into these?

indicators.note: losing tells us a letter is lost from the verb

parts.note: to pine is to long, yearn

indicators.note: primarily picks the first letter

explanation.surface: Felled pine trees, needles stripped, end up as firewood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pines' looks like the trees but is the verb longs; 'losing needles primarily' drops its N.
explanation.definitionFit: Felled pines are sawn into lengths of trunk for burning or milling.

clue.text: Tree in Maracaibo yielding saccharin now and then

indicators.note: now and then means occasionally, so only every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: A Venezuelan tree that occasionally oozes a sweetener.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in Maracaibo' tempts you to find the answer hidden there; it is part of the definition, and the letters come from alternate letters of saccharin.
explanation.definitionFit: The acai palm grows in tropical South America, where Maracaibo is a Venezuelan city.

clue.text: Fruit shakes managed to impress youth leader

indicators.note: to impress is to press in, so the letter goes inside
managed means handled or arranged, so the letters are reordered
the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A smoothie-maker fixed some shakes to win over a youth group's leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'managed' turns SHAKES into ASHKES; Y from 'youth leader' goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Ash keys are the winged seed clusters of the ash tree.

clue.text: People present decorated stand with tree

indicators.note: decorated suggests the letters have been dressed up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Guests at a show where a stand and a tree have been trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who attend an event are the ones who are there in person.

clue.text: Firm invested in fast car for special race

indicators.note: invested in means put inside

parts.note: the E-Type is a classic Jaguar sports car
CO, company, is a firm

explanation.surface: A company puts money into a sports car for a particular race.
explanation.definitionFit: An ecotype is a distinct population of a species adapted to local conditions.

clue.text: Green planks, not Fair Trade

parts.note: green means raw, inexperienced
deal is pine or fir sawn into planks

explanation.surface: Eco-friendly timber that lacks a Fair Trade label.
explanation.definitionFit: Unfair treatment in a bargain is idiomatically a raw deal, the opposite of a fair one.

clue.text: Nobody in particular is fit to tour city

indicators.note: to tour a place is to go round it, so the letters enclose the city

parts.note: A1 means in fine condition, fit
NY is short for New York City

explanation.surface: No particular person is well enough to travel round a city.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 is written as AONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Anyone means whichever person, not a specific individual.

clue.text: Chaffinch initially rebuilt nest in shed for horse

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter
the rebuilt letters go in the shed

parts.note: a hut is a shed

indicators.note: rebuilt means the letters are put together again in a new order

explanation.surface: A chaffinch remakes its nest in a shed used for a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rebuilt' gives ESTN, placed 'in' the shed.
explanation.definitionFit: A chestnut is a horse of reddish-brown colour.

clue.text: Ordinary power returns to a capital

indicators.note: returns means comes back, so the unit is read backwards

parts.note: the watt is the unit of power

explanation.surface: Normal electricity supply is restored to a capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' makes TTAW.
explanation.definitionFit: Ottawa is the capital city of Canada.

clue.text: Vast expanse of 8 and one of its denizens, say?

indicators.note: say tells us the word is spoken

parts.note: the Siberian tiger lives in the northern forests

explanation.surface: A huge forest, and a creature that lives there, if you say it.
explanation.walkthrough: The 8 refers to the answer at 8 down, so the definition is a vast expanse of planted woodland, in effect forest.
explanation.definitionFit: Taiga is the huge belt of coniferous forest across Siberia and the far north.

clue.text: Study old diary as part of basic thematic study

parts.note: a den is a private room for study

indicators.note: these letters become part of the plain word, sitting inside it

parts.note: dry, as in plain and unadorned, means basic
a log is a daily record or diary

explanation.surface: Studying an old journal as part of some fundamental research.
explanation.walkthrough: The puzzle's theme is trees, so the study of trees is the thematic study; the opening 'Study' is a room.
explanation.definitionFit: Dendrology is the scientific study of trees, the subject running through this grid.

clue.text: Tree oil extracted, not all of it

indicators.note: not all of it says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some oil has been drawn from a tree, but not completely.
explanation.definitionFit: Ilex is the holly genus, and also the holm oak.

clue.text: Special trees make containers for glass

parts.note: ash trees, in the plural

explanation.surface: Particular trees are made into glass holders.
explanation.definitionFit: Sash windows hold their panes in sliding wooden frames called sashes.

clue.text: Minor item ideal for twisting round top of tree

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go round the single letter
twisting puts the letters out of shape into a new order
the top of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A small item that would be perfect for winding round the top of a tree, like a decoration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisting' turns IDEAL into DEAIL; 'round' puts the T from 'top of tree' inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A detail is a small particular or point of minor importance.
